text: We used to dare each other to ask Danny's uncle about his arm.
He only ever said one thing.
A wolf took it. On this street.
We thought he was mad.
Silver nails in the windowsill. Wolfsbane over the door.
Every full moon, he sent us home before dark.
Then he'd stand at the end of the road all night.
Watching the houses.
We called him Wolfman Mick.
Mick died last week.
I came home for the funeral. Slept in my old room.
First full moon in twenty years, with nobody at the end of the road.
I woke at three.
The window was open. Mud on the sill.
Then Danny texted.
Mum finally told me how Mick lost his arm.
The summer we were ten.
The night you went missing.
I don't remember going missing.
Mick wasn't watching for wolves getting in.
He was watching for one getting out.
Mick?
